get.description:
Things worth looking at in the session, each with the comparison that shows it. The first
request reads the best laps' telemetry (and in 2026 every clean lap, for clipping).
DRS zones (until 2025) or the straights with where the session clips (2026), for the map.

Straight-mode zones (2026) from the FIA's circuit map, ended where the session brakes, and
when race control declared low-grip conditions.

Races (2026): every passage of the overtake detection line, with the gap to the car ahead
and whether it gave overtake mode. Needs the position track (404 until it is prepared).

Qualifying: how much quicker the track got over the session (per driver corrected for
his level and the tyre), and what each best lap was worth on the track of the end.

schema.title: Response Live Sessions Api Live Get

get.description: Whether the recorder runs, and what it would record.

post.description:
Start recording the session on now; `wait`: or wait for the next one. The recorder is its
own process: it goes on when the backend restarts.

delete.description: Stop the recorder (it closes the recording first).

get.description:
Server-sent events: a `status` event (LiveSessionInfo) whenever the data horizon or the
version moves (a new version means new laps: refetch the session's data), and a `positions`
event with the new points of the position track: {first, count, cars} as in /positions, from
grid point `first` on. Points from before the connection come from /positions.

ClockPoint.title: ClockPoint
ClockPoint.description:
F1's session clock from session time `t` on: `remaining` seconds, counting down if
`running` (stopped under a red flag and between qualifying parts).

ComparedLap.title: ComparedLap
ComparedLap.description: A lap resampled onto the comparison's shared distance grid.

CompoundPace.title: CompoundPace
CompoundPace.description: The field's degradation on one compound: stint fits combined.

CornerLap.title: CornerLap
CornerLap.description: One lap through one corner segment.

CornerSegment.title: CornerSegment
CornerSegment.description: A corner (or chicane) with its braking zone and the straight after it.

DegFit.title: DegFit
DegFit.description: Fuel-corrected lap time = base + slope × tyre age, fitted on the stint's clean laps.

Downshift.title: Downshift
Downshift.description:
A downshift at full throttle on a straight, faster than 200 km/h: keeps the engine at or
above 10,500 rpm (full fuel flow in 2026) while the car loses speed and harvests.

DriverRace.title: DriverRace
DriverRace.description: One driver's race lap by lap, columnar: index i is lap laps[i].

Duel.title: Duel
Duel.description:
Undercut and overcut against one car around the driver.

first[k − 1]: the driver stops on the next lap and the rival k laps later; second[k − 1]: the
rival stops on the next lap and the driver k laps later. Both are seconds the driver gains on
the rival once both have stopped (negative = loses), on top of the gap now.

EnergyComparison.title: EnergyComparison
EnergyComparison.description: Estimated energy deployment (2026): where laps stop gaining speed at full throttle.

EnergyStraightLap.title: EnergyStraightLap
EnergyStraightLap.description:
One lap on one straight. Distances (m) on the reference lap's scale, like /compare;
negative = before the line (the main straight runs on from the previous lap).

EnergyStraightStats.title: EnergyStraightStats
EnergyStraightStats.description: A straight over a set of clean laps: shares and medians.

EvolutionDriver.title: EvolutionDriver
EvolutionDriver.description: A driver's best push lap, and what it was worth on the track of the end.

EvolutionLap.title: EvolutionLap
EvolutionLap.description: A push lap in the track-evolution fit.

LapPrediction.title: LapPrediction
LapPrediction.description:
What the lap a driver is on at t is on course for: his best lap until t plus the delta so
far. Only push laps: not on an out-lap, not in the first 300 m, not 1 s or more down.

LapProgress.title: LapProgress
LapProgress.description:
The lap a driver is on at session time t, as far as it got (replay: a finished lap cut off
at t; live: the samples so far), on a distance grid over the reference lap with the delta to
it. Values past where the car is are null, so a chart over the whole lap grows.

LiveSessionInfo.title: LiveSessionInfo
LiveSessionInfo.description: A session recorded from the live timing feed (app/live), live or done.

MarkerIn.title: MarkerIn
MarkerIn.description: A marked point or range: lap distance (m) or session time (s). `end` null = a point.

MarshalSector.title: MarshalSector
MarshalSector.description: A marshal sector (yellow flags are per marshal sector) as a lap-distance range (m).

OvertakeCheck.title: OvertakeCheck
OvertakeCheck.description: One car crossing the overtake detection line (estimated from the position track).

OvertakeChecks.title: OvertakeChecks
OvertakeChecks.description: Every passage of the overtake detection line in a race (2026); empty without one.

OvertakePoints.title: OvertakePoints
OvertakePoints.description:
Overtake mode (2026, races): within 1 s of the car ahead at the detection line, a car gets
extra MGU-K energy to use from the activation line. Metres from the line, like the zones
(a corner's position plus the metres: ±50 m).

PitWindow.title: PitWindow
PitWindow.description:
A pit stop for one driver at the cutoff: where he rejoins, and undercut/overcut on the cars
ahead and behind. Tyre model from Degradation; pit loss from the circuit.

ProgressReference.title: ProgressReference
ProgressReference.description: The finished lap the lap in progress is measured against, on the same grid.

RaceHistory.title: RaceHistory
RaceHistory.description: The session lap by lap for every driver: what gap, position and stint charts need.

RecorderStatus.title: RecorderStatus
RecorderStatus.description: The live recorder (app/live/record.py), started from the top bar or with `make live`.

Rejoin.title: Rejoin
Rejoin.description: Where a car comes out after a pit stop now, if nobody else stops.

ReplayPositions.title: ReplayPositions
ReplayPositions.description: Every car on a fixed time grid: sample i is at session time start + i * step.

ReplayStatus.title: ReplayStatus
ReplayStatus.description: Preparing the position track: every lap's telemetry is downloaded once (~10 s for a race).

ReportAction.title: ReportAction
ReportAction.description: What a click on a line of the report opens.

ReportClipping.title: ReportClipping
ReportClipping.description: 2026: a driver who loses most to clipping, against the one who loses least.

ReportCorner.title: ReportCorner
ReportCorner.description: Where a driver's best lap loses most to the fastest lap of the session.

ReportMoment.title: ReportMoment
ReportMoment.description: Something that happened in a race, at a moment on the clock.

ReportRun.title: ReportRun
ReportRun.description: A long run in practice: at least 5 laps at pace on one set.

ReportStint.title: ReportStint
ReportStint.description: A stint whose degradation stands out (fuel-corrected fit).

SectorFlag.title: SectorFlag
SectorFlag.description: A yellow flag in one marshal sector, from race control.

Segment.title: Segment
Segment.description: A qualifying part (Q1, Q2, Q3) in session time.

SessionReport.title: SessionReport
SessionReport.description: Things worth looking at in a session, each with the comparison that shows it.

SessionTimeline.title: SessionTimeline
SessionTimeline.description: What the session clock needs: its range, the laps and the track status over time.

SetupDriver.title: SetupDriver
SetupDriver.description: One driver's best lap: how fast on the straights against how fast through the corners.

SetupMap.title: SetupMap
SetupMap.description: Top speed against cornering speed per driver (best laps): low drag or high downforce.

StraightMode.title: StraightMode
StraightMode.description: Straight-mode zones of the event (2026) from the FIA's circuit map; empty without one.

StraightModeZone.title: StraightModeZone
StraightModeZone.description:
Where straight mode (2026, both wings flat) may be used. Distances in metres from the line
on a lap of the session's usual length; a start below zero runs on from the previous lap.

TeammatePair.title: TeammatePair
TeammatePair.description: One team's drivers, the one with the quicker best lap first.

Telemetry.title: Telemetry
Telemetry.description: One lap, columnar, at the source sample rate (~4 Hz car data merged with position).

TimingState.title: TimingState
TimingState.description: The timing tower at session time `time`, valid from valid_from until valid_until.

TrackEvolution.title: TrackEvolution
TrackEvolution.description:
Qualifying: how much quicker the track got, per driver corrected for his level and the
tyre (an estimate; anything that makes everyone quicker over time counts).

TrackSectors.title: TrackSectors
TrackSectors.description: Where the timing sectors end along the lap, for the map.

TrackZone.title: TrackZone
TrackZone.description:
A stretch to mark along the track. Distances in metres from the line on a lap of the
session's usual length; a start below zero runs on from the previous lap.

TyreSet.title: TyreSet
TyreSet.description: One set of tyres as far as the data shows (it has no set numbers: chained by age).

TyreWeekend.title: TyreWeekend
TyreWeekend.description: Every driver's tyre sets over the weekend up to and including this session.

ViewState-Input.title: ViewState
ViewState-Input.description: What a saved view restores. The layout is dockview's JSON, opaque to the backend.

ViewState-Output.title: ViewState
ViewState-Output.description: What a saved view restores. The layout is dockview's JSON, opaque to the backend.

Weather.title: Weather
Weather.description: Columnar, about one sample per minute.

WeekendLongRun.title: WeekendLongRun
WeekendLongRun.description: A driver's longest run in practice (the race simulation; median lap, no fuel correction).

WeekendOverview.title: WeekendOverview
WeekendOverview.description: Every driver from the first practice to this session, in the order of the latest one.
